description: This file defines an Android Activity and composable UI components for a streaming platform app. It includes a homepage with a header, hero banner, and carousel rows of content cards, with focus handling for TV navigation. It utilizes Jetpack Compose for UI layout, Coil for image loading, and custom focus and border effects for TV remote navigation.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity that sets the composable HomeScreen() as content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Activity lifecycle method to set up UI content.

methods.name: HomeScreen
methods.description: Main composable function rendering header, banner, and carousels.

methods.name: HeaderBar
methods.description: Displays logo, navigation buttons, and avatar with focus handling.

methods.name: FocusablePillText
methods.description: Custom focusable text that shows focus styling like background and font weight.

methods.name: HeroBanner
methods.description: Displays a hero banner image, eager loading specified.

methods.name: CarouselRow
methods.description: Displays a row of content cards with title, supporting different content types.

methods.name: PosterProgressCard
methods.description: Content card with image, progress bar, and title.

methods.name: TvChannelCard
methods.description: Content card for TV channels with overlay, play button, and info, designed for TV navigation.

methods.name: Modifier.borderGlow
methods.description: Extension modifier to add glow border effect around focus.

methods.name: StreamXTVTheme
methods.description: Defines app theme using Material3 color scheme and typography.
